pages.lesson:
LESSON: READING 10.2.1 STUDY SKILLS: NOTE MAKING

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.2: Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do we determine what to include in our notes during note making?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify key points in a text

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify key points in a text
   In simple words: practise until you can identify key points in a text. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making in the examples.
2. Explain Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making.
4. Show that you can: identify key points in a text

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read a given text on art and identify the key points,
2. Create own abbreviations and display on a chart,
3. Discuss some of the words that are used to introduce key points in a piece of writing,
4. Digital literacy: It is enhanced as the learner interacts with technology as they use electronic devices to get information.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we determine what to include in our notes during note making?
2. What is the importance of note making?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify key points in a text

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
